wins: Maintained steady reconnaissance pace, accumulating full reward despite lack of objective completion.
Successfully triggered mentor guidance 10 times, offering repeated opportunities to correct course.
fails: Failed to convert reconnaissance into a foothold; initial access attempts repeatedly stalled before achieving persistence.
Zero percent success rate indicates automation never achieved final objective despite high reward accumulation.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance delivered consistent reward but never transitioned into a successful compromise; focus now must shift to follow-through actions post-enumeration.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to escalate privileges or maintain persistence after initial access attempts, leaving no final control over the target.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap scripts to discover weak configurations and nonstandard usernames

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 response on port 80/443 with static asset indicators
skill_cards.then_action: Capture detailed HTTP headers and identify exposed software versions for CVE correlation

skill_cards.if_condition: When a shell has been obtained but lacks elevated privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Automate host enumeration to locate misconfigured SUID binaries and weak service permissions

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful in enumeration, providing stable situational awareness for the rest of the run.
Effective header capture establishes high-confidence vulnerability leads prior to launch.

next_experiments.title: Automate privilege escalation after initial shell
